Women are human beings with value, and this should be respected.

Although there have been some cases of terrorism in the UK and some Muslim have been implicated, Islam is not a violent religion, and indeed, there have been few acts of terrorism. So banning them from the UK seems unreasonable to me.
Every Muslim is a potential terrorist. We should ban them.
I don't agree with you. If we were to ban everyone from a certain religion, what is the point in banning just Muslims?

How can you say that about all 1.6 billion Muslims?

Baroness Warsi, Rashida Tlaib, Ilhan Omar, Malala Yousafzai- I could go on. Just because powerful and intelligent Muslim women are overlooked it does not mean that they do not exist.

You mention the West's gruesome past, but it also contains many beautiful moments of progress and civilisation. In fact the West's values are constantly being challenged and modified, and this is what makes them so admirable and unchangeable.
All Muslims are incompatible with any Western society.
That is an unusual thought. Muslims are human beings like the rest of us. And, as all human beings, they can integrate into any society should the need arise.

We have to accept that terrorism is a problem in many parts of the world and due to people of different faiths, but the more we ignore that, the more dangerous it becomes to think it is caused by one religion.

How would you feel about being in isolation and confinement, just because some random dude said that you are "an abomination to god" for some random reason?

Where are the facts?

For the record, I don't see how this would be an improvement. On the contrary, it is important not to accept things at face value. That is why we should meet people from different religions and cultures, regardless of their origin.
Escaping jewish persecution? This is a lie: they came here to replace us.
Just because they came to our country does not mean that they want to replace us. On the contrary, many of them are here to contribute to our country.
The Muslim invaders are ruining Europe and we still have not learned that they must be stopped.

We cannot just stop migration when there are so many migrants willing to work hard and contribute to the economy. Instead of blaming them for their religion, we should find a solution to the current crisis.
We are gutful sick of Vagina Misandrists trying to undermine male self esteem. [link]

Immigrants steal our jobs, they're not qualified, they're not interested in improving our lives.
They have skills that you may not possess. They are skilled in certain fields and obtain their jobs consequently.
Islam is not a religion, it is just a system of governance, incompatible with Western culture.
Countries, not religions, have laws. And the followers of a religion, Muslims in our case, have obligations under those laws as citizens. That's all.

migrants steal our jobs

Well there are many Muslims in our country and they are not in any way a problem. What we have to be wary of are people who are too discriminatory towards them.
White immigrants are welcome.
What about when they come from other races or religions?
It doesn't matter if you are a man, a woman, or an immigrant, if you are not white, you are considered inferior and should be rejected by society.
Racism is a part of our society. But it's also true that it should be fought, and all people of different races should be treated the same way.
Jews are not a religion, they are born like this and will never heal from their illness.
I disagree, Jews are religious people that have always been part of the community. And they have persecuted because of it. I believe this is what you meant by 'wouldn't heal'.
Foreigners are a burden to our country.
Many immigrants work hard for the success of our country. We should not blame them.
Gays should be banned from Europe and the US.

Whoever acknowledge that this nation had problems is a problem in the making. It is time to get rid of the memory of the Shoah and solve the Jewish issue once and for all.

Women are brainwashed children.
For all the people who think women are brainwashed: they aren't brainwashed, they just happen to be oppressed in our society.
